title: Device composes Systemsoftware
description: The device hosts the system software installed on it, such as the operating system, language runtimes and tools on a developer workstation or an appliance's firmware platform. Mirrors node composes systemsoftware for physical hardware.
x-dr-evidence: ArchiMate 3.2 §10.2.2: a Device is a specialization of Node, and system software can be deployed on it.
DR's catalog already allows technology.node composes technology.systemsoftware.
